result.summary: Several layout and content clipping issues make restaurant names and category chips appear broken or cut off, plus minor truncation on delivery info.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card is clipped on the right edge; restaurant name shows as 'Trattoria Piccol' and the card/image is only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousels fully show cards or use consistent peek/padding so names and images are not cut mid-word.

issues.description: Category filter chips overflow the screen; the chip after 'Healthy' is only a partial oval with no label visible.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll with proper end padding, or wrap/resize chips so none are cut off at the viewport edge.

issues.description: Restaurant title under the pizza card is missing or scrolled out of view while the image and -20% badge are shown, creating an incomplete listing.
issues.suggestion: Keep title, meta row, and image together in each list item so content is not partially off-screen on initial load.

issues.description: Search placeholder text appears slightly cramped/low-contrast in the pill field and could be harder to read at a glance.
issues.suggestion: Increase placeholder contrast and vertical padding inside the search field for clearer readability.
